messages:
support-lucy: FYI — customer acme-x reporting sudden p99 latency spike on /v1/chat.generate starting ~06:30 UTC. p95 mostly stable, but p99 jumped ~4x. attaching short logs. any quick mitigations? :warning:

eli: Which model/variant? Did they hit a flash-attn optimized variant or sdpa?

support-lucy: model: redwood/gpt-medium-7b-ql6, variant: sdpa+flash (quantized). We rolled the new compile flag `-fuse-flashattn` in last night's deploy.

maya: I see autoscale churn at that time but nodes came up fine. GPUs show higher tail latency — suspect kernel selection fallback to an unoptimized path. Repro request in-flight.

jack: Can we toggle FLASHATTN at runtime? The nodepool runtime reads `USE_FLASHATTN` env. We can flip to 0 for a canary. Suggest 10% canary first.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy 3110005560 started: rollout compileflag-toggle -> 10% nodes (user jack)

eli: Pushed canary -> `USE_FLASHATTN=0` and restricted kernel whitelist to `sdpa` on those pods. Monitoring graphs now.

maya: Early telemetry from canary: p99 dropped from ~3.2s -> ~850ms, p95 unchanged. Promising sign that flash kernel path was misbehaving for these shapes.

support-lucy: Customer asking for ETA/brief explanation. If canary holds, do we plan full rollback or targeted patch?

jack: Rollback looks safest for now. Executing full rollback: `kubectl set env deployment/rt-pool USE_FLASHATTN=0 --all` (ops approved).

ops-bot: rollout 3110005601 completed: compileflag toggle rollback -> 100% nodes in 2m 12s

eli: After rollback p99 returned to baseline ~290ms. Collecting kernel traces and reproducer logs to pinpoint regression.

maya: Next steps: add a runtime guard: avoid selecting FlashAttention for seq_len>1024 on this model until kernel patch. Also add canary heuristics to detect tail regressions automatically. Filing ticket INF-4521.

support-lucy: Thanks — relaying to customer. They requested a short postmortem once we have root cause.

jack: I'll start a postmortem draft in #postmortems. Please paste repro steps and traces here.

eli: Log snippets from affected worker:
```
[worker-12] kernel select: candidate=flashattn kernel_id=53 score=0.82
[worker-12] exec -> flashattn kernel_id=53 latency_ms=120 profile_ok=false
[worker-12] fallback -> sdpa kernel_id=12 latency_ms=1230 p99=1.23s
```

maya: Repro command I'm running locally: `python repro.py --model redwood/gpt-medium-7b-ql6 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --use_flashattn true` — hitting the tail in ~30 runs.

eli: Tagging @kernel-team @eng-sre for follow-up and kernel patch. Also adding telemetry alert to block future automatic rollouts of the compile flag until gated by regression tests.

support-lucy: :thumbsup: customer updated. Will escalate to their engineering lead if anything else pops up.
